claims.claim: Complete engine for Toyota vehicles like SUVs and Crossovers
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly, but do not show vehicle compatibility details (engine code/fitment) or any listing text beyond the seller’s statement.
No clearly readable engine code/part number or RAV4-specific identification is visible on the engine in photos 0-2.

risks.risk: Wrong engine variant/engine code (e.g., different RAV4 engines or different years) leading to mismatch with mounts, sensors, or ECU/loom.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped engine code on the block/head (and/or the VIN/engine number label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case fitment risk: treat as not guaranteed to match your exact RAV4 variant (so value reduced accordingly).

risks.risk: Not working / seized / damaged internally (photos can’t confirm compression, crank rotation, or oil pressure).
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine cranking and running (or at minimum, a start-up video) plus a short sound check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working (or unknown condition) until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete kit (starter, alternator, sensors, brackets, timing-related parts) even if it looks 'complete'.
risks.proof: Photo of the full engine laid out with a checklist: show all accessories and key sensors/brackets; also show the underside/bottom and both sides.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: assume some parts may be missing).

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox not included or not compatible (seller says 'complete engine' but buyers often need engine + gearbox + mounts).
risks.proof: Confirm what is included: ask for a photo showing what comes with it (gearbox attached or separate) and the gearbox code if attached.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine only (no gearbox) unless photos show gearbox attached.

risks.risk: Overheating or oil/coolant leaks (grime may hide cracks, warped surfaces, or coolant/oil mixing).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket areas (head gasket edges, oil pan seam, coolant hose connections) and any wetness/leaks after a run.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing inspection/possible reseal (worst case: assume leaks may exist).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code on the block/head (the exact characters must be readable).
Video of the engine cranking and running (or at least cranking with ignition) showing it starts.
Photos showing exactly what is included: whether gearbox is attached, and all accessories/sensors/brackets present.
Close-ups of gasket/seal areas and any visible leak points (oil pan, valve cover edges, coolant connections).
response.reason: The photos show a Toyota engine assembly, but the exact engine variant/fitment (RAV4 XA20) and working condition cannot be confirmed from the images. Without the engine code and proof of running, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
